title: StampRallyCard
description: One attendee's stamp rally record at stampRallyCards/{uid}. Only the owner and admins can read it; scanStampRallyCode is the only writer and uses server time. The stamp count is the number of entries in stamps. Fields appear on first use. Auth account deletion removes the document.

stamps.description: Acquisition time keyed by sponsor id.

rewardsRedeemedAt.description: Redemption time keyed by the 1-based checkpoint number as a string.

thanksCardRedeemedAt.description: Thanks card redemption time, independent of stamp progress.
